Comment: I've played a clash before with the exact same objective and concept. I don't have the link to it unfortunately, but I just know that I have played a clash like this in the past. Can't allow repeats; sorry

The clash you were thinking of was probably this one:

https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/98421eebdf8a4332fac37966058c862ddb849

I'm not sure why [[N]] is restricted to odd integers there, though.

I'd suggest slightly modifying the task:
* for even [[N]], fill the grid the same way as currently required
* for odd [[N]], fill the grid from N² down to 1 instead of from 1 up to N²
